study type: Quality assessment analysis of prospectively collected observational data
exposure: Helping Babies Breathe (HBB) resuscitation training as part of a continuous quality improvement (CQI) program
cohort: 31,122 newborns born in a rural referral hospital in northern-central Tanzania
finding: Implementation of the HBB CQI project, including frequent HBB training, was associated with significant improvement in perinatal survival, despite a concomitant increase in high-risk deliveries.
